title: otel/pyproject.toml's SDK floor is the release the adapter's log and span code needs
goal: otel/pyproject.toml names opentelemetry-sdk from the release that has LogRecordExportResult and Logger.emit(event_name=...), re-locked with uv lock --project otel

run:
import re,sys
m=re.search(r'opentelemetry-sdk>=([0-9.]+)',open('otel/pyproject.toml',encoding='utf-8').read())
v=tuple(int(x) for x in m[1].split('.')) if m else (0,)
print(v);sys.exit(0 if v>=(1,39) else 1)

notes: SP-qvlnptiw: the ST-vau24eqm worker found the floor >=1.30 while the code relies on the pinned 1.45.1; the floor in the check (1.39) is a guess to be read from the SDK changelog by the item.
